concept.title: Animal records
concept.shortdesc: An animal record holds everything your shelter knows about one animal: who they are, where they are, their health, and their history with you.

conbody.p: Open any record to see its tabs:

ul.li: Profile: name, breed, age, size, color, microchip, and a public description for adoption listings.
Medical: vaccinations, treatments, weight history and spay/neuter status.
Behavior: temperament notes, playgroup compatibility and handling alerts.
Timeline: every event, newest first, with who recorded it.
Documents: intake forms, vet records and signed adoption contracts.

section.title: Handling alerts
section.p: When an animal needs special handling, for example "two-person handling" or "no small dogs", add a handling alert on the Behavior tab. Alerts appear as a red banner wherever the animal is shown, including on kennel cards and in the app.

section.title: Returning animals
section.p: If an animal comes back to your shelter, reopens the existing record instead of creating a new one, so you keep the animal's full history.
